$description: Familista Design Core — canonical design tokens (W3C DTCG format). Source of truth; every renderer (CSS generator, Storybook, future Design System Control) consumes this file.

ref.$description: Reference layer: raw values only, named by colour family and step. Never referenced by product code directly.

navy.$description: Approved Familista navy ramp (Penpot Step 1); live in Familista Vision.

mist.$description: Approved text ramp; live across the Owner modules.

semantic.$description: Semantic layer. Default values are the live Club Workspace values (body.club-theme is on for every page); the Owner context re-declares them.

com.familista.source: club --tx-3 (what _lg renders; contrast baseline failure); owner --*-tx-3

module.$description: Module / page identity accent. Defaults to the brand accent; each module re-declares it.

com.familista.source: owner: Vision outline var(--v-cyan); no live Club equivalent
live literals: 1px hairlines, 2px focus outline, 3px accent rule
--font 'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif + Noto Sans Arabic fallback (Arabic glyphs only)
Stage 0 decision: Noto Sans Arabic is the Arabic fallback
no live tokens; scale from live literal frequency (11px×381, 12px×369, 10px×286, 13px×271 …)
no live tokens; live backdrop-filter literals blur(3|6|10|14|18|20px)
no live tokens; most frequent live control heights (26px, 32px, 36px)
no live tokens; most frequent live square icon rules (15px×4, 16px×3, 18px×2)

team.$description: Amber is the current club (CLAUDE.md); the opponent is steel.

result.$description: Green and red mean a result or availability and nothing else.

categorical.$description: The live series set shared by .sqlu-stat--* and .trn-stat--*. Green (2) and red (6) collide with result meanings — a Stage 3 decision.

multiplier.$description: Multiply a horizontal transform by this so it mirrors under dir="rtl".

context.$description: Workspace context. Club is the default (live today on every page); Owner re-declares the semantic layer.

module.$description: Module identity accents, from each module's live --*-accent / --*-accent-2.

theme.$description: Colour themes. Dark is the default (:root, html[data-theme="dark"]). Light and high contrast are reserved: no tokens until approved.

ar.$description: Arabic: letter-spacing breaks cursive joining, so every tracking step is 0.
